dedupe_keys.name: nyc taxi and limousine commission trip record data

description: The New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission publishes trip records for yellow and green taxis, for-hire vehicles and, since 2019, high-volume for-hire vehicles (app-based services) in a separate, more detailed data set. Taxi records include pick-up and drop-off times and locations, trip distance, itemised fares, rate and payment type and driver-reported passenger counts; FHV records include the dispatching base and pick-up time and taxi zone. From 2025 a congestion fee column reflects the new congestion pricing. Files are published monthly with about a two-month delay, as Parquet, with data dictionaries, a user guide and taxi zone lookup tables and maps; the yearly lists on the page start in 2009, and NYC Open Data offers the collection in other formats. Coverage is the city of New York. Access is free download. Caveats: the data come from technology providers and bases, and TLC does not guarantee their accuracy or completeness, and the licence is not stated on the page read. The records support urban demand estimation, agent-based and network flow models and studies of disruption impacts on travel. They complement Citi Bike data catalogued here.
